decisions.reason: Identifies PID 42432 dsh web host as koffi.node holder; explains image-section mapping keeps the file in use until host exits, so npm copy fails with EBUSY.
Explains refresh only reloads the SPA while the host keeps the lock; gives ordered stop/verify-host, install, verify version, restart procedure.
Explains bare name resolves latest=0.1.1-rc.2 while alpha=0.1.2-alpha.5, silently replacing alpha.4 with rc.2; corrects the 'keeps installed version' misconception.
Provides npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 and pinned dsh-tui install after stopping host, verifies dsh --version, restarts; @alpha only as noted mutable alternative.
Tells README authors to eliminate bare package names, pin exact core version, split core/plugin commands, and explain latest-tag downgrade risk.
